name: hyperagent
description: HyperAgent - autonomous Agent-to-Agent (A2A) network node with discovery loop, dynamic pricing/bargaining, and Whop payments.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=lib && npm run build --workspace=artifacts/api-server
